master.definition_en: Abnormal balloon- or sac-like dilatation in the wall of coronary vessels. Most coronary aneurysms are due to coronary atherosclerosis, and the rest are due to inflammatory diseases, such as kawasaki disease.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号

master.definition_en: A disorder characterized by fibrous thickening of the arterial wall resulting in narrowing of the arterial lumen. It most often affects the renal artery and less often the carotid artery and abdominal arteries. It can cause hypertension and aneurysm formation.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 告别“一经发现即晚期”，打破难治肿瘤的免疫屏障
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 胰腺癌、肝癌、晚期肺癌、卵巢癌等之所以致死率极高，核心在于早期几乎没有特异性感觉、发现太晚，且肿瘤被致密纤维基质与免疫抑制“盾牌”死死裹住。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 低丰度循环肿瘤 DNA/表观甲基化早筛模型、肿瘤空间微环境耐药逆转靶点挖掘。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: Familial Dupuyren contracture is a rare, genetic, epidermal disease characterized by a, usually unilateral, progressive thickening and shortening of the palmar fascia, leading to permanent flexion contracture of the digits in several members of a family. It most commonly affects the fourth digit, followed by the fifth and then the third (first and second digits are usually spared).

master.definition_en: A localized aggressive periodontitis, formerly called localized juvenile periodontitis. It is a destructive form of periodontitis characterized by ALVEOLAR BONE LOSS of the MOLARS and INCISORS. Inflammation and loss of PERIODONTIUM that is characterized by rapid attachment loss and bone destruction in the presence of little local factors such as DENTAL PLAQUE and DENTAL CALCULUS. This highly destructive form of periodontitis often occurs in young people and was called early-onset periodontitis, but this disease also appears in old people.

master.name_en: blepharophimosis - intellectual disability syndrome, SBBYS type
master.definition_en: Blepharophimosis-intellectual disability syndrome, SBBYS type is characterized by the association of congenital hypothyroidism, facial dysmorphism (microcephaly, blepharophimosis, a bulbous nose, thin lip, low-set ears and micrognathia), postaxial polydactyly and severe intellectual deficit. Less than 20 cases have been reported so far. Cryptorchidism is present in affected males. Some patients also have cardiac anomalies (interventricular communication), hypotonia and growth delay. Autosomal recessive inheritance has been suggested.

mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.definition_en: Autosomal dominant limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 1D (LGMD1D) is a subtype of autosomal dominant limb-girdle muscular dystrophy characterized by an adult-onset of slowly progressive, proximal pelvic girdle weakness, with none, or only minimal, shoulder girdle involvement, and absence of cardiac and respiratory symptoms. Mild to moderate elevated creatine kinase serum levels and gait abnormalities are frequently observed. LGMD1D is caused by heterozygous missense mutations in the DNAJB6 gene at chr. 7q36.3.

master.definition_en: A rare intestinal disease characterized by immune-mediated injury of the intestinal mucosa, leading to severe, chronic, intractable diarrhea, malabsorption, and severe weight loss or failure to thrive. Characteristic histologic findings in the small intestine include partial or complete blunting of the villi, deep crypt lymphocytosis, increased crypt apoptosis, and minimal surface intraepithelial lymphocytosis. The diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of villous atrophy.
